branded.why: A well-sold brand, but one supermarket brand among many, no part of a food culture of its own.

about.text: An aged Goudse kaas, matured about a year in a historic cheese warehouse in Woerden by the Van den Wijngaard family. The family started trading cheese in 1934.

sources.text: Its ageing, its warehouse and the family's start, from this page.
